shorts.rule: A share qualifies when its price is at least 30% above our own fair value and it trades under its 200-day average.

rebalance.method: Every position above its limit (30% for one company, 35% for one fund) is cut to the limit; positions under their limit are left alone; 3% is kept as cash; the money released goes into the funds the engine's target-volatility mix uses, in the same proportions. Done in 3 parts about a month apart. A position you chose to keep is never trimmed by this plan. Volatility is worked out from the last 252 trading days of prices and is an estimate.
